fact: The CNSS said the January 2026 retirement and survivor pensions would be paid from 23 December 2025 through bank transfer and mobile telephony.

Guinea's CNSS says that from July 2025 it ends cash payment of retirement, survivor and invalidity pensions, moving to bank transfer, mobile wallets and rechargeable cards, with a campaign to migrate pensioners.

The public social security fund CNSS officially launched on 5 December 2023 payment of retirement pensions by bank transfer or mobile money (Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money), with an awareness campaign for pensioners running to 14 December 2023.
